# Study Time Statistics 2.3.0

## 中文

- 新增“分析筛选”，可以按日期、文件夹和笔记名称筛选本地阅读会话。
- 自动对比等长的上一周期，并显示时长变化。
- 可以从筛选结果下钻到具体会话和原始笔记。
- 所有筛选和计算均在本地完成，不上传笔记名称或统计数据。
- “分析筛选”整合进“统计分析”子页，并补齐独立统计卡片样式和单语界面。

## English

- Adds Analysis Explorer with local date, folder, and note-name filters.
- Compares the selected range with the preceding range of equal length.
- Supports drill-down from summary metrics to sessions and source notes.
- All filtering remains local; note names and analytics are never uploaded.
- Integrates Filter & Compare into Analytics with distinct metric cards and language-aware labels.
